description: Where a person can get a free daily email when something changes: pass what to follow and get the subscribe URL to show them. kind = sku (a SKU id from search_skus: its price changes and retirement), provider (any change of a provider slug such as anthropic), category (vps, gpu, llm, inference or media), index (a series slug from get_index: moves of 5% or more) or new_model (new models of a provider). The person opens the URL, types their email address, confirms by link and gets at most one mail a day with a one-click unsubscribe. Nothing is sent from here and no address is taken by this tool. Returns an error object for an unknown target.
